messages:
Rae: Quick design check on Routing Policies editor. Two recurring user confusions in usability test: list order vs numeric precedence, and unclear validation when priorities collide. Owen: Seen that. Proposal: make list order the canonical source of truth and surface a small label: 'Order controls routing'. Keep numeric precedence visible but secondary. Sofia: Can we add an affordance to lock the numeric field? e.g., a small padlock to indicate it's read-only until 'Edit precedence' is toggled. Helps power users and prevents accidental renumber. Ken: Accessibility: keyboard reordering is mandatory. Suggest Ctrl/Cmd+Up/Down when a row has focus; expose the action in the row's context menu. Also ensure the reorder handle has aria-roledescription='reorder'. Rae: Validation copy needs softer language. Draft: 'Priority collision — two rules share the same priority. Choose a distinct priority or use Auto-resolve.' Add an inline 'Auto-resolve' CTA that renumbers and shows a changelog toast with Undo. Owen: Simulator behavior: currently it snaps away on hover out. Make it sticky until ESC or close click. Also add aria-live='polite' and aria-atomic='true' to the results container. Sofia: Small code snippet to share with eng for SRs:
If country == 'CA'
Results...
 Ken: Fine by me. Also recommend announcing when Auto-resolve runs: 'Auto-resolve complete. Rule X moved to position 3.' Use a non-blocking toast. Rae: Can design produce two quick comps (default and edit-precedence) showing focus rings and keyboard hints? Prefer review tomorrow at 2pm. a11ybot: Created UX-4217: 'Routing editor — precedence clarity, keyboard reorder, and simulator accessibility' assignees: Sofia, Ken; priority: Medium; due: 2024-07-09. Owen: I'll split UX-4217 into three tickets and add tokenizer parity as a dependency. Thanks team.
